0320_audit_read_relations.schema.json.title: Audit read-only event relations
0320_audit_read_relations.schema.json.$comment: Read-only owner relation, not an authorization decision. Trusted consumers retain their existing filters, project scope, ordering, pagination and caller-owned transaction. PostgreSQL bigint IDs use canonical signed decimal strings in JSON; INET remains native in PostgreSQL and is rendered by each client boundary.

AuditReadEvent.description: Lossless JSON row representation of one `audit_events` relation row.
AuditReadEvent.title: AuditReadEvent

0322_audit_daily_projection.schema.json.$comment: Read-only daily aggregate of completed UTC days. The caller retains its existing authorization, month boundaries, raw-tail mixing and transaction. Event counts use canonical decimal strings in JSON.

AuditDailyFact.description: Lossless JSON representation of a row in ``audit_daily_facts``.
AuditDailyFact.title: AuditDailyFact

0322_audit_daily_projection.schema.json.title: Audit daily aggregate projection

0333_audit_maintenance.schema.json.title: Audit partition maintenance commands
0333_audit_maintenance.schema.json.$comment: Partition names encode their first-day UTC month and next-month upper bound. Ensure accepts only first-day dates; archive keys must match the partition month. Commands remain in the caller transaction. Snapshot locks the identified partition ACCESS EXCLUSIVE; drop requires that lock in the same transaction. The archive object is written before drop.

AuditPartition.description: Frozen identity and UTC date range for one monthly audit partition.
AuditPartition.title: AuditPartition
